what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from May, August and September 2020 at a remote meeting.
The principal assessor reported the Vision software conversion is ahead of schedule and covered the recap sheet, billing and exemptions.
The board agreed to break and meet again at about 2:20 for executive session, which must be a separate meeting.
The open meeting was closed and the board went to executive session without returning to open session.
Roll call was delayed because one member was missing and connection problems arose.

why_it_matters: The Vision conversion is the software behind property valuation records and tax billing, so a schedule running ahead lowers the risk of delays to bills and exemptions.
The executive session was not reopened to the public, so the minutes record no decision from it.
